CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3666.                                SHANGHAI,        5th November 1937.

Sir,

    I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No. D. 4209 dated the 4th instant regarding Mr.
Anatoly V. Fiskel and to thank you for the information
contained therein.

                                    I have the honour to be,
                                        Sir,
                                    Your obedient servant,

                                    Acting Consul-General.

                                        AB

The Deputy Commissioner,
    Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
        SHANGHAI.

November 29 37.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. 3875 dated 23rd November, 1937,
and in reply to inform you that there is nothing
in Municipal Police records detrimental to the
character of Mr. Anatoly O. Pickel. A copy of
report on this individual is attached.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Acting Consul-General,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 86441
Date November 28, 37

Subject Communication dated 25-11-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Mr. A.O. Pickel .
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Enquiries show that Anatoly Oswald PICKEL alias
Prince A.O. MOZBJKO-PLIKL, Russian of Lithuanian origin, was born
on July 27, 1890, at Petrograd. Former officer of the Russian Im-
perial Navy he is reported to have seen active service during the
Great War in 1914-1918 and subsequently in the ranks of Admiral
Kolchak's army in Siberia from 1918 to 1920.

In 1920 he arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok.
Here he was employed as Second Officer on board the various ves-
sels of Butterfield & Swire and China Merchants' Steam Navigation
Companies until November of the same year when he was engaged by
the Public Health Department, S.M.C., as a sanitary overseer. At
present he holds the position of a health inspector in the same
Department.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Commit-
tee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and resides at 51 Route Boissezon, apt. 1,
together with his wife and four children.

Nothing detrimental is known by this office re-
garding this person.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch )
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 86441
日期 1937 年 11 月 28 日

事由：荷兰总领事馆 1937 年 11 月 25 日来函，涉及 A.O. Pickel 先生。
由警探长 Prokofiev 制作。经 **〔此处转录不清〕** 转呈

经查，Anatoly Oswald PICKEL，别名 A.O. MOZBJKO-PLIKL 亲王，俄籍，立陶宛裔，1890 年 7 月 27 日出生于彼得格勒。据报他曾是俄罗斯帝国海军军官，在 1914-1918 年大战期间服役，随后于 1918 年至 1920 年间在科尔恰克海军上将的西伯利亚军队中服役。

1920 年，他从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。
在此地，他受雇于太古轮船公司（Butterfield & Swire）和招商局轮船公司（China Merchants' Steam Navigation Companies）的多艘船只，担任二副，直至同年 11 月被上海公共租界工部局卫生处聘为卫生监督员。目前，他在该部门担任卫生视察员一职。

他在慕尔鸣路 118/1 号的俄国侨民委员会登记注册，现与其妻子及四个子女共同居住在蒲石路 51 号 1 室。

本处未掌握任何关于此人的不利信息。

A. Prokofiev
警探长

特务科副总监

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3875.

SHANGHAI, 23 November, 1937.

（右上角手写批注：REGISTERED B. D. 8202 25 / 11 37）
（左侧边缘手写批注：X Notorious
mend i S. P. Reg.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Anatoly
O. PICKEL alias Prince Mozjko has applied to this Consulate
for a vise for admission into the Netherlands-Indies.
Mr. Pickel, who is connected with the Public Health
Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council, stated to me
that he intends to travel to the Netherlands-Indies in order
to start business for his own account.
He is in possession of a "travelling certificate" issued
by the Bureau of Police of the City Government of Shanghai,
No. 753, issued at September 30, 1937, valid for one year,
and also of a letter of recommendation from the Public Health
Department of October 7, 1937.
According to this certificate he is born at Petrograd, at
July 27, 1890.
He resides at Shanghai at 51 Rte Boissezon Apartment 1.
I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known about this person
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为签名〕
Act. Consul-General.

The Deputy Commisioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（左下角手写批注：D.S.I. 〔此处转录不清〕 C 35/4 25/11）
（右下角印章及批注：S/ 〔椭圆章内含花押〕 24 NOV 1937）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第 3875 号。

上海，1937 年 11 月 23 日。

（右上角手写批注：REGISTERED B. D. 8202 25 / 11 37）
（左侧边缘手写批注：X Notorious mend i S. P. Reg.）

先生：

谨此告知，Anatoly O. PICKEL 先生（别名 Mozjko 亲王）已向本领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。Pickel 先生与上海公共租界工部局卫生处有关联，他向本人表示，打算前往荷属东印度自行经商。
他持有上海特别市政府警察局签发的第 753 号“旅行证明书”，签发日期为 1937 年 9 月 30 日，有效期一年；此外还持有卫生处于 1937 年 10 月 7 日出具的推荐信一封。
根据该证明书，他于 1890 年 7 月 27 日出生于彼得格勒。
他现居住于上海蒲石路 51 号 1 室。
如蒙告知是否掌握此人在政治或道德方面的任何情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处为签名〕
代理总领事。

副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科，
上海。

（左下角手写批注：D.S.I. 〔此处转录不清〕 C 35/4 25/11）
（右下角印章及批注：S/ 〔椭圆章内含花押〕 1937 年 11 月 24 日）
